title: Refactor CI/tooling: add dependency lifecycle annotator, lightweight lint proxy, and compatibility shim
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: Our presubmit pipelines have grown ad-hoc annotations for dependency lifecycle and readonly metadata in package manifests which makes automated tooling brittle and release automation noisy. This PR introduces a small, opt-in dependency lifecycle annotator service and a lightweight lint proxy to centralize presubmit-only rules. The annotator tags package manifests with machine-readable lifecycle metadata (stable/unsupported/experimental) and writes an annotations file under .ci/annotations.json for downstream stages to consume. The lint proxy provides a stable adapter between team-level lint configs and the monorepo presubmit runner so we can standardize lint exit codes and reduce duplicate rule ownership friction. A compatibility shim adapts legacy makefile targets and older release hooks to the new presubmit loader; this reduces bursty failures during rollout.

What this changes: single-line summary of changes (full list below): 1) New tool: tools/dep_lifecycle/annotator.py — inspects package manifests, consults the dep policy, emits annotations and a small caching layer. 2) Presubmit loader: ci/presubmit/loader.go — now reads .ci/annotations.json and exposes a lightweight API for other presubmit stages (fast path for unchanged modules). 3) Lint proxy: ci/lint/proxy.ts — a shim that normalizes different lint runners' outputs and maps to standardized presubmit severity levels. 4) Workflows: .github/workflows/presubmit.yml updated with an annotation-loading step and a new quick-lint job used for fast feedback. 5) Backwards-compatible shim: tools/compat/release-shadow.sh and make/compat.mk with guarded targets to preserve old developer flows.

Commits summary: - Add annotator implementation and tests - Wire annotator into presubmit bootstrap - Add lint proxy and couple of adapter modules for eslint/golangci-lint - Update presubmit workflow and add quick-lint job - Add compat shim and integration smoke tests - Fix flakiness in presubmit loader using a small exponential backoff for remote cache

Files changed (high level): ["tools/dep_lifecycle/annotator.py", "tools/dep_lifecycle/README.md", "ci/presubmit/loader.go", "ci/presubmit/loader_test.go", "ci/lint/proxy.ts", "ci/lint/adapters/eslint_adapter.ts", "ci/lint/adapters/golangci_adapter.ts", "make/compat.mk", "tools/compat/release-shadow.sh", ".github/workflows/presubmit.yml", ".ci/annotations-template.json", "docs/ci/annotator.md"].

Testing and CI notes: The PR initially failed the integration-smoke job because the annotator's cache path defaulted to /tmp and the integration runner ran with a noexec mount. I pushed a follow-up commit to honor CI provided TMPDIR and added a check to fallback to a repo-local cache under .ci/cache. After the fix, full CI passed: lint (pass after adapter updates), unit (pass), integration-smoke (pass on second run), e2e-release-smoke (pass), security-scan (pass). A limited rollout was done in staged presubmit lanes to validate that the quick-lint job reduced feedback latency by ~45% on typical PRs.

Migration plan and rollout: The annotator is opt-in per-package via a new field in package.yaml: ci.dependency_lifecycle: true|false. Teams can opt-in immediately; default behavior remains unchanged until the annotator runs as a presubmit step in all lanes. The lint proxy is behind a feature flag in the presubmit config: presubmit.lint_proxy.enabled. We communicated the rollout window on the internal #ci-tooling slack channel and provided a one-week grace period for team-level config updates. The compatibility shim guards are annotated and the old targets remain available for two weeks before we flip defaults.

Related work: ENG-7642 (dep taxonomy), ENG-7701 (presubmit fastpath), SUP-3412 (customer-reported flaky releases). Links to docs: docs/ci/annotator.md and tools/dep_lifecycle/README.md.

review_comments: Maya Kapoor: Nice consolidation. Two requests: 1) the annotator needs to skip binary package scans (we should only operate on manifest files), and 2) please add metrics (count of annotated packages) so rollout telemetry is visible.
Ava Martinez (author): Good catch, added a manifest-only filter and exported a prometheus counter in the annotator. See commit 3.

Liam O'Connor: The lint proxy maps some eslint error codes to 'error' severity today; can we reduce that mapping to 'warn' for non-blocking stylistic rules to preserve fastpath throughput? Also, please add a short migration FAQ for teams that have custom eslint rules.
Ava Martinez: Adjusted mapping and added docs/ci/annotator.md + tools/dep_lifecycle/README.md with FAQ and a sample migrate.sh snippet.
Diego Ramos: Integration smoke flaked in CI on first run due to cache path. After the cache fix I re-ran and the integration-smoke job passed. Approving.
Maya Kapoor: approval after small nits were addressed. Left a few inline comments on test timeouts to consider for follow-ups.
release_notes: Add opt-in dependency lifecycle annotator and lightweight lint proxy; adds presubmit annotation artifact.
notes: Release notes above summarize user-visible changes. Teams must opt-in per package to begin getting annotations; rollout was gated and default behaviors preserved during the staged rollout.
post_merge_actions: Turn on annotator in fastpresubmit lanes for opted-in packages after config window
Monitor metric ci.annotator.annotated_packages and presubmit latency dashboards for regressions
Schedule a follow-up to remove compat make targets in two weeks (ENG-7701 follow-up)
